YOUR QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

Before you choose.

Do standard jewellery sizes apply?

Use the Oura Ring 4 sizing kit and official fit guidance instead of relying on a standard jewellery size.

Is the Ring 5 sizing kit the same?

Choose the kit for the generation you intend to buy. Oura identifies Ring 4 and Ring 5 sizing kits separately.
